config.key.title: Craftable
config.title: Craftable Settings
config.generic.title: Generic
config.generic.name.include_ender_chest: Use nearby ender chests to access the personal ender inventory
config.generic.comment.unlocked_only: Display preference only. When off, the book shows all synchronized crafting recipes without unlocking them.
config.generic.comment.recipe_book_enhan: Enable Craftable status and shortcuts in the vanilla recipe book.
config.generic.comment.detailed_failure_: When disabled, failure toasts show a generic reason without changing server decisions.
config.generic.comment.horizontal_radius: Maximum blocks scanned east and west from the player's block. The current scan shape is a box.
config.generic.comment.vertical_radius: Maximum blocks scanned above and below the player's block.
config.generic.comment.preview_cache_tic: Caches recipe-book previews only; creation always rescans. Set to 0 to disable caching.
config.generic.comment.include_ender_che: Allow access to the current player's own ender inventory when a usable ender chest is nearby.
command.environment.summary: Craftable environment: generation %s, dimension %s, origin %s, horizontal/vertical range %s/%s, %s resource endpoints, %s workstations.
message.create.failed: Crafting failed; enable detailed failure reasons in the client config for more information.
message.create.recipe_not_found: Crafting failed: the server could not find that recipe.
message.create.unsupported_recipe: This recipe is not supported for one-key crafting yet.
message.create.missing_workstation: Crafting failed: a required crafting table is not nearby.
message.create.missing_ingredients: Crafting failed: the work environment lacks ingredients.
message.create.no_output_space: Crafting failed: there is no room for the output.
message.create.environment_changed: Crafting cancelled: the work environment changed; try again.
message.create.invalid_context: Crafting failed: use a survival or adventure inventory or workbench.
message.create.request_throttled: That was too fast; try again in a moment.
message.create.internal_error: Crafting failed: the transaction errored and materials were restored.
message.create.recipe_locked: Crafting failed: this world requires the recipe to be unlocked first.
toast.create.failed.title: Unable to Craft
tooltip.rules_unknown: Open your inventory in a world to read its effective server rules.
tooltip.rules: Server rules: box radius %s horizontal / %s vertical; preview cache %s ticks; ender chest: %s.
reason.recipe_not_found: recipe not found on the server
reason.missing_ingredients: not enough ingredients in the work environment
reason.invalid_context: use a survival or adventure inventory or workbench

reason.internal_error: transaction could not be completed safely
